parts.text: local P=ThePlayer local C=P.HUD.controls local M=TheWorld.minimap.MiniMap local H=select(2,TheSim:GetScreenSize()) local s=C.virtualstick s.IsTouchPositionOnStick=function(a,x,y) local b=a.bg:GetWorldPosition() local dx,dy=x-b.x,y-b.y return math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)<=200*(a:GetWorldScale().x/a:GetLooseScale()) end if C.mt then C.mt:Cancel() C.mt=nil end if P._mmw then P._mmw:Cancel() end if not M:IsVisible() then M:ToggleVisibility() end M:ResetOffset() M:Offset(0,-.6*H/9) P._mmW=function() if ThePlayer~=P or not P.HUD then if P._mmw then P._mmw:Cancel() P._mmw=nil end return end local o=P.HUD:IsMapScreenOpen() if not o and not P._mmo and not M:IsVisible() then M:ToggleVisibility() end local g=C.mm if g then local v=not(o or P._mmo) if g.shown~=v then if v then g:Show() else g:Hide() end end end if P._mmp and not o then M:ResetOffset() M:Offset(0,-.6*H/9) end P._mmp=o end P._mmw=P:DoPeriodicTask(.4,function() P._mmW() end) --M

parts.label: Add the brain-badge minimap show/hide toggle
parts.text: local P=ThePlayer local C=P.HUD.controls local M=TheWorld.minimap.MiniMap local b=C.status.brain b._oc=b._oc or b.OnControl P._mmt=function() if not C.mm or not P._mmW then return end local T=GetTime() if P._mmz and T-P._mmz<.4 then return end P._mmz=T if P._mmo then P._mmo=nil b:SetFadeAlpha(1) if not P._mmw then P._mmw=P:DoPeriodicTask(.4,function() P._mmW() end) end P._mmW() ChatHistory:SendCommandResponse([[minimap on]]) else P._mmo=true b:SetFadeAlpha(.4) C.mm:Hide() if not P.HUD:IsMapScreenOpen() and M:IsVisible() then M:ToggleVisibility() end ChatHistory:SendCommandResponse([[minimap off]]) end end b.OnControl=function(s,c,d) if (c==CONTROL_ACCEPT or c==CONTROL_PRIMARY) and not d then P._mmt() return true end return s._oc(s,c,d) end --M

parts.label: Set up Beefalo detection and the bell warning scan
parts.text: function MW_Bell(p,b) return p.components.inventory:FindItem(function(i) return i.GetBeefalo and i:GetBeefalo()==b end) end local p=ThePlayer if p._bd then p._bd:Cancel() end local pm=p.components.rider:GetMount() p._bd=p:DoPeriodicTask(.5,function() local m=p.components.rider:GetMount() if m and m~=pm and not MW_Bell(p,m) then p.components.talker:Say([[No bonded bell!]],3) end if pm and not m and pm:IsValid() then local x,_,z=p.Transform:GetWorldPosition() local h=TheSim:FindEntities(x,0,z,8,{[[hitcher]]},{[[INLIMBO]]})[1] local b=pm if h and h.components.hitcher then p:DoTaskInTime(1,function() local ok,r=false,[[NOBELL]] if b:IsValid() and MW_Bell(p,b) then ok,r=ACTIONS.HITCHUP.fn(BufferedAction(p,h,ACTIONS.HITCHUP)) end if not ok then p.components.talker:Say([[Hitch failed: ]]..tostring(r),3) end end) end end pm=m end) --M

parts.label: Find a nearby Beefalo and check its hitch state
parts.text: local p=ThePlayer function MW_BF(id) local x,_,z=p.Transform:GetWorldPosition() local b for _,e in ipairs(TheSim:FindEntities(x,0,z,12,{[[_health]]},{[[INLIMBO]]})) do local o,i=pcall(function() return e.Network:GetNetworkID() end) if o and i==id and e.components.hitchable then b=e end end local c=b and b.components.hitchable if not c then return end local h=c:GetHitch() if h and not(type(h)==[[table]] and h.components and h.components.hitcher) then h=nil local bx,_,bz=b.Transform:GetWorldPosition() for _,e in ipairs(TheSim:FindEntities(bx,0,bz,8,nil,{[[INLIMBO]],[[hitcher]]})) do if e.components.hitcher then h=e break end end end return b,h end --M

parts.label: Perform the automatic hitch or unhitch action
parts.text: local p=ThePlayer function MW_BeefGo(id) local b,h=MW_BF(id) if not b or p.components.rider:IsRiding() then return end if h then ACTIONS.UNHITCH.fn(BufferedAction(p,h,ACTIONS.UNHITCH)) end local I=p.components.inventory local _,t=I:Has([[twigs]],1) local _,g=I:Has([[cutgrass]],1) local f=(t>0 or g>0) and (t>=g and [[twigs]] or [[cutgrass]]) local it=f and I:FindItem(function(i) return i.prefab==f end) if it then ACTIONS.FEED.fn(BufferedAction(p,b,ACTIONS.FEED,it)) end local warned=false local n,k=0 k=p:DoPeriodicTask(.4,function() n=n+1 if p.components.rider:IsRiding() then if not warned then warned=true if not MW_Bell(p,b) then p.components.talker:Say([[No bonded bell!]],3) end end k:Cancel() return end if n>12 then k:Cancel() return end ACTIONS.MOUNT.fn(BufferedAction(p,b,ACTIONS.MOUNT)) end) end --M

parts.label: Send remote hitch commands from the virtual stick
parts.text: local P=ThePlayer local S=P.HUD.controls.virtualstick P._bw=function(e,n,wx,wz) local A=MW_AR local function go() TheNet:SendRemoteExecute([[MW_BeefGo(]]..n..[[)]],wx,wz) end if not A or P.replica.rider:IsRiding() then go() return end if P._bk then P._bk:Cancel() end local c=0 P._bk=P:DoPeriodicTask(.15,function() c=c+1 if S.touchID~=nil or not e:IsValid() then A.stop() P._bk:Cancel() return end local px,_,pz=P.Transform:GetWorldPosition() local bx,_,bz=e.Transform:GetWorldPosition() local dx,dz=bx-px,bz-pz local d=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz) if d<=3 or c>60 then A.stop() P._bk:Cancel() go() return end local r,u=TheCamera:GetRightVec(),TheCamera:GetDownVec() A.hx=(dx*r.x+dz*r.z)/d A.hy=-(dx*u.x+dz*u.z)/d A.on=true end) end --M

parts.label: Create touch controls and manage hitch interactions
parts.text: local P=ThePlayer for _,h in ipairs(rawget(_G,[[MW_TH]]) or {}) do h:Remove() end if P._bk then P._bk:Cancel() P._bk=nil end local S={} local a=TheInput:AddTouchStartHandler(function(i,x,y) S[i]={x,y} end) local b=TheInput:AddTouchEndHandler(function(i,x,y) if P~=ThePlayer or not P._bw then return end local s=S[i] S[i]=nil if not s or math.abs(s[1]-x)+math.abs(s[2]-y)>25 or TheInput:GetHUDEntityAtPoint(x,y) then return end local wx,_,wz=TheSim:ProjectScreenPos(x,y) if not wx then return end for _,e in ipairs(TheSim:FindEntities(wx,0,wz,3,{[[_health]]},{[[INLIMBO]]})) do if e.prefab==[[beefalo]] then local o,n=pcall(function() return e.Network:GetNetworkID() end) if o and n then P._bw(e,n,wx,wz) end return end end end) MW_TH={a,b} --M

parts.text: local P=ThePlayer local C=P.HUD.controls if C.bs2 then C.bs2:Kill() end local Wd,Im=require[[widgets/widget]],require[[widgets/image]] local B=C:AddChild(Wd([[bs2]])) C.bs2=B B:MoveToBack() B.D={} B.Q={} for i=1,200 do local d=Im([[images/global.xml]],[[square.tex]]) B:AddChild(d) d:ScaleToSize(4,4) d:Hide() B.D[i]=d end --M

parts.label: Find nearby blockers and calculate valid planting spots
parts.text: local P=ThePlayer local B=P.HUD.controls.bs2 local R,N=30,48 B.F=function() local x,_,z=P.Transform:GetWorldPosition() local L={} for _,e in ipairs(TheSim:FindEntities(x,0,z,100,{[[lunarthrall_plant]]})) do local a,_,b=e.Transform:GetWorldPosition() L[#L+1]={a,b} end local Q={} for i,c in ipairs(L) do for j=0,N-1 do local t=j*6.2832/N local px,pz=c[1]+R*math.cos(t),c[2]+R*math.sin(t) local ok=#Q<#B.D for m,o in ipairs(L) do if m~=i and (px-o[1])^2+(pz-o[2])^2<R*R then ok=false break end end if ok then Q[#Q+1]={px,pz} end end end B.Q=Q end --M

parts.label: Update the rangefinder display while placing or planting
parts.text: local P=ThePlayer local C=P.HUD.controls local B=C.bs2 local pc=P.components.playercontroller local w=C:GetWorldPosition() local k=C:GetScale().x B.t=0 B.OnUpdate=function(s,dt) local D=B.D if not(pc.placer or pc.deployplacer) then if B.v~=false then B.v=false for i=1,#D do D[i]:Hide() end end return end B.v=true B.t=B.t-dt if B.t<=0 then B.t=.5 B.F() end for i=1,#D do local q,d=B.Q[i],D[i] if q then local a,u=TheSim:GetScreenPos(q[1],0,q[2]) d:SetPosition((a-w.x)/k,(u-w.y)/k) d:SetTint(.2,1,.3,.8) d:Show() else d:Hide() end end end B:StartUpdating() --M

parts.text: MW_AL={} function MW_AL.ix() local v=Profile:GetAxisAlignedPlacementIntervals() for i,o in ipairs(AXISALIGNMENT_VALUES) do if o.data==v then return i end end return 1 end function MW_AL.lb() return tostring(AXISALIGNMENT_VALUES[MW_AL.ix()].text) end function MW_AL.go(d) local V=AXISALIGNMENT_VALUES local v=V[math.max(1,math.min(#V,MW_AL.ix()+d))].data Profile:SetAxisAlignedPlacementIntervals(v) TUNING.AXISALIGNEDPLACEMENT_INTERVALS=v ThePlayer:PushEvent([[refreshaxisalignedplacementintervals]]) Profile:Save(function() end) end function MW_AL.mk(n,s,d) local C=ThePlayer.HUD.controls if C[n] then C[n]:Kill() end local b=C:AddChild(require[[widgets/imagebutton]]([[images/global_redux.xml]],[[arrow2_]]..s..[[.tex]],[[arrow2_]]..s..[[_over.tex]],[[arrow2_]]..s..[[_disabled.tex]],[[arrow2_]]..s..[[_down.tex]])) C[n]=b b:SetOnClick(function() MW_AL.go(d) end) b:Hide() return b end --M

parts.text: local Tx=require[[widgets/text]] local P=ThePlayer local C=P.HUD.controls local W,H=TheSim:GetScreenSize() local w=C:GetWorldPosition() local k=C:GetScale().x local b1,b2=MW_AL.mk([[alb]],[[left]],-1),MW_AL.mk([[alt]],[[right]],1) if C.alx then C.alx:Kill() end local t=C:AddChild(Tx(UIFONT,18,([[]]))) C.alx=t t:Hide() b1:SetPosition((1.025*H-w.x)/k,(0.262*H-w.y)/k) t:SetPosition((1.1111*H-w.x)/k,(0.263*H-w.y)/k) b2:SetPosition((W-1.0278*H-w.x)/k,(0.2639*H-w.y)/k) local pc=P.components.playercontroller if P._alt then P._alt:Cancel() end P._alt=P:DoPeriodicTask(.2,function() if pc.placer or pc.deployplacer then t:SetString(MW_AL.lb()) b1:Show() b2:Show() t:Show() else b1:Hide() b2:Hide() t:Hide() end end) --M

parts.label: Find matching dropped items and group compatible stacks
parts.text: function MW_Grp(it) if not it:IsValid() then return end local K=function(f) return f:match([[_blueprint$]]) or f:match([[_sketch$]]) or f end local k=K(it.prefab) local x,_,z=it.Transform:GetWorldPosition() local L={} for _,o in ipairs(TheSim:FindEntities(x,0,z,5,nil,{[[INLIMBO]]})) do local v=o.components.inventoryitem if v and not v:IsHeld() and K(o.prefab)==k then L[#L+1]=o end end for _,a in ipairs(L) do local s=a:IsValid() and a.components.stackable if s then for _,b in ipairs(L) do if a~=b and b:IsValid() and b.components.stackable and not s:IsFull() then s:Put(b) end end end end local n,nd for _,o in ipairs(L) do if o:IsValid() and o~=it then local q=o:GetDistanceSqToPoint(x,0,z) if not nd or q<nd then n,nd=o,q end end end if not n then return end local a,_,c=n.Transform:GetWorldPosition() for _,o in ipairs(L) do if o:IsValid() and o~=n and o.Physics then o.Physics:Teleport(a,0,c) end end end --M

parts.label: Run the grouping behavior when an item is dropped
parts.text: local p=ThePlayer if p._ds then p:RemoveEventCallback([[dropitem]],p._ds) end p._ds=function(_,d) local it=d and d.item if not(it and it.components.inventoryitem and it.Physics) or it.sg or it.Light or it.components.health or it.components.locomotor or it:HasTag([[heavy]]) then return end local ph=it.Physics local ok,g=pcall(ph.GetCollisionGroup,ph) local o2,m=pcall(ph.GetMass,ph) if (ok and g~=COLLISION.ITEMS) or (o2 and m==0) then return end it:DoTaskInTime(.7,function() if it:IsValid() then pcall(MW_Grp,it) end end) end p:ListenForEvent([[dropitem]],p._ds) --M

parts.label: Add scrolling support to the chat screen
parts.text: function MW_F(o,d) if o.can_scroll_fn then return o end if d<4 then for c in pairs(o.children or {}) do local r=MW_F(c,d+1) if r then return r end end end end function MW_R(L,d) local lo,hi=0,1 while hi<4096 and L.can_scroll_fn(d*hi,d*(hi-1)) do lo=hi hi=hi*2 end while hi-lo>1 do local m=math.floor((lo+hi)/2) if L.can_scroll_fn(d*m,d*(m-1)) then lo=m else hi=m end end return lo end --M

parts.label: Detect touch input and handle chat-screen dragging
parts.text: function MW_In(s) local G=s.MW_g local p=TheInput:GetScreenPosition() local H=G.H return math.abs(p.x-(G.W-.04*H))<.05*H and p.y>.3*H-30 and p.y<.7*H+30 end function MW_Drag(s) local G,L=s.MW_g,s.MW_L if not(G and L and s.MW_lo) then return end local H=G.H local f=math.max(0,math.min(1,(TheInput:GetScreenPosition().y-.3*H)/(.4*H))) L:Scroll(math.floor(s.MW_hi-f*(s.MW_hi-s.MW_lo)+.5)-L.target_scroll_pos,true) end function MW_Upd(s,dt) local G=s.MW_g if not G then return end s.MW_L=s.MW_L or MW_F(s.networkchatqueue or s,0) local L=s.MW_L if not L then if not s.MW_e then s.MW_e=1 Networking_SystemMessage([[bar: list not found]]) end return end s.MW_c=(s.MW_c or 0)-(dt or 0) if s.MW_c<=0 then s.MW_c=.3 s.MW_lo=-MW_R(L,-1) s.MW_hi=MW_R(L,1) end if s.MW_d then MW_Drag(s) end local sp=s.MW_hi-s.MW_lo local f=sp>0 and (s.MW_hi-L.current_scroll_pos)/sp or 0 G.h:SetPosition(G.x,-G.L/2+math.max(0,math.min(1,f))*G.L) end --M

parts.label: Create the chat-screen scroll and resize controls
parts.text: function MW_Bar(s) local Wd,Im,IB=require[[widgets/widget]],require[[widgets/image]],require[[widgets/imagebutton]] local g=s:AddChild(Wd([[mw]])) g:SetScaleMode(SCALEMODE_PROPORTIONAL) g:SetHAnchor(ANCHOR_MIDDLE) g:SetVAnchor(ANCHOR_MIDDLE) local W,H=TheSim:GetScreenSize() local w={x=W/2,y=H/2} local k=H/RESOLUTION_Y local b=g:AddChild(IB([[images/global_redux.xml]],[[close.tex]],[[close.tex]],[[close.tex]])) b:SetScale(.55) b:SetPosition((W-0.06*H-w.x)/k,(H-0.08*H-w.y)/k) b:SetOnClick(function() s.MW_stay=false s:Close() end) local L,x=.4*H/k,(W-0.04*H-w.x)/k local t=g:AddChild(Im([[images/global.xml]],[[square.tex]])) t:SetClickable(false) t:SetTint(1,1,1,.3) t:ScaleToSize(12,L) t:SetPosition(x,0) local h=g:AddChild(Im([[images/global.xml]],[[square.tex]])) h:SetClickable(false) h:SetTint(.9,.75,.3,.9) h:ScaleToSize(22,64) h:SetPosition(x,-L/2) s.MW_g={h=h,x=x,L=L,W=W,H=H} end --M

parts.label: Keep the chat screen open and handle its touch controls
parts.text: local S=require[[screens/chatinputscreen]] S.MWK=S.MWK or S.Close S.Close=function(s,...) if s.MW_stay then return end return S.MWK(s,...) end S.MWO=S.MWO or S.OnControl S.OnControl=function(s,c,d,...) if s.MW_g and (c==CONTROL_PRIMARY or c==CONTROL_ACCEPT) then if d then s.MW_d=MW_In(s) or nil if s.MW_d then return true end elseif s.MW_d then s.MW_d=nil return true end end return S.MWO(s,c,d,...) end S.MWU=S.MWU or S.OnUpdate S.OnUpdate=function(s,dt,...) S.MWU(s,dt,...) if s.MW_stay==nil then s.MW_stay=true end local o,e=pcall(function() if s.MW_g==nil then s.MW_g=false MW_Bar(s) end MW_Upd(s,dt) end) if not o and not s.MW_x then s.MW_x=1 Networking_SystemMessage([[bar: ]]..tostring(e)) end end --M

parts.label: Find nearby Fig trees and calculate spacing
parts.text: local P=ThePlayer local B=P.HUD.controls.bs local R,N,MAX=2,48,15 B.F=function() local x,_,z=P.Transform:GetWorldPosition() local L={} for _,e in ipairs(TheSim:FindEntities(x,0,z,MAX)) do local f=e.prefab or "" if f==[[oceantreenut]] or f==[[underwater_salvageable]] or f==[[oceantree]] or f==[[winch]] then local a,_,b=e.Transform:GetWorldPosition() if(a-x)*(a-x)+(b-z)*(b-z)<=MAX*MAX then L[#L+1]={a,b} end end end local Q={} for i,c in ipairs(L) do for j=0,N-1 do local t=j*6.2832/N local px,pz=c[1]+R*math.cos(t),c[2]+R*math.sin(t) local ok2=#Q<#B.D for m,o in ipairs(L) do if m~=i and(px-o[1])^2+(pz-o[2])^2<R*R then ok2=false break end end if ok2 and(px-x)*(px-x)+(pz-z)*(pz-z)<=MAX*MAX then Q[#Q+1]={px,pz} end end end B.Q=Q end --M

parts.label: Draw and toggle the spacing indicators
parts.text: local P=ThePlayer local C=P.HUD.controls local B=C.bs local SW,SH=TheSim:GetScreenSize() B.on=false B.t=0 B.OnUpdate=function(s,dt) local D=B.D if not B.on then for i=1,#D do D[i]:Hide() end return end B.t=B.t-dt if B.t<=0 then B.t=.5 if B.F then B.F() end end local wp=C:GetWorldPosition() local sc=C:GetScale().x local Q=B.Q or{} for i=1,#D do D[i]:Hide() end for i=1,#Q do local q,d=Q[i],D[i] if not d then break end local a,u=TheSim:GetScreenPos(q[1],0,q[2]) if a and u and a>-40 and u>-40 and a<SW+40 and u<SH+40 then d:SetPosition((a-wp.x)/sc,(u-wp.y)/sc) d:SetTint(1,.3,.6,.8) d:Show() end end end --M

S.MWB(s,...) local r=s.root or s local W,H=TheSim:GetScreenSize() local k=r:GetScale().x local w=r:GetWorldPosition() if s.MW_bb then s.MW_bb:Kill() end local b=r:AddChild(IB([[images/hud.xml]],[[equip_slot.tex]],[[equip_slot.tex]],[[equip_slot.tex]])) s.MW_bb=b b:SetScale(.9) b.image:SetTint(1,1,1,.35) b:SetPosition((0.3657*H-w.x)/k,(0.2722*H-w.y)/k) b:SetOnClick(function() B.on=not B.on if B.on then if not B.updating then B:StartUpdating() end B.t=0 if B.F then B.F() end b.image:SetTint(.4,1,.5,.8) Networking_SystemMessage([[bs on]]) else B.Q={} for i=1,#B.D do B.D[i]:Hide() end b.image:SetTint(1,1,1,.35) Networking_SystemMessage([[bs off]]) end end) end --M

parts.label: Create the Ageless Watch button
parts.text: local C=ThePlayer.HUD.controls if C.ab1 then C.ab1:Kill() C.ab1=nil end if C.ab then C.ab:Kill() C.ab=nil end local T=C.right_root local b=T:AddChild(require[[widgets/imagebutton]]([[images/global.xml]],[[square.tex]])) C.ab1=b local W,H=TheSim:GetScreenSize() local w=T:GetWorldPosition() local k=T:GetWorldScale().x b.image:SetScale(1.1/k) b:SetPosition((W*.694-w.x)/k,(H*.224-w.y)/k) b:Hide() b:SetOnClick(function() local P=ThePlayer local L=(P._Ls1 or {})[1] if not(L and L:IsValid()) then return end local I=P.replica.inventory if I.UseItemFromInvTile then I:UseItemFromInvTile(L) else P.components.playercontroller:DoAction(BufferedAction(P,nil,ACTIONS.CAST_POCKETWATCH,L,P:GetPosition())) end end) --M:wanda

parts.label: Create the Backstep button

label: GRAMOPHONE PLAYS INDEFINITELY
description: For farmers. Normally the gramophone stops after about 62 seconds.

parts.label: Gramophone continuous playback
parts.text: local function P(i) if i.MW_inf then return end i.MW_inf=1 i.TurnOffMachine=function(i) if i.components.machine:IsOn() then local s=i:GetRecordSong() if s and not i.SoundEmitter:PlayingSound([[ragtime]]) then i.SoundEmitter:PlaySound(s,[[ragtime]]) end i._stop_song_task=i:DoTaskInTime(TUNING.PHONOGRAPH_PLAY_TIME,i.TurnOffMachine) end end if i._stop_song_task then i._stop_song_task:Cancel() i._stop_song_task=nil end if i.components.machine:IsOn() then i._stop_song_task=i:DoTaskInTime(TUNING.PHONOGRAPH_PLAY_TIME,i.TurnOffMachine) end end local function S() for _,e in pairs(Ents) do if e.prefab==[[phonograph]] and e.components.machine then P(e) end end end if TheWorld.MW_pg then TheWorld.MW_pg:Cancel() end TheWorld.MW_pg=TheWorld:DoPeriodicTask(5,S) S() --M

parts.label: Create the Quick Telepoof button
parts.text: local C=ThePlayer.HUD.controls if C.bl then C.bl:Kill() C.bl=nil end local T=C.right_root local b=T:AddChild(require[[widgets/imagebutton]]([[images/global.xml]],[[square.tex]])) C.bl=b b.scale_on_focus=false local W,H=TheSim:GetScreenSize() local w=T:GetWorldPosition() local k=T:GetWorldScale().x b.image:SetScale(1.4/k) b:SetPosition((W*0.8479-w.x)/k,(H*0.3731-w.y)/k) b:Hide() --M

parts.label: Update the button based on equipped teleport staff
parts.text: local P=ThePlayer if P._blt then P._blt:Cancel() end P._blt=P:DoPeriodicTask(.4,function() local b=P.HUD.controls.bl if not b then return end local I=P.replica.inventory local o=I:GetOverflowContainer() local f for _,s in ipairs{I:GetItems(),I:GetEquips(),o and o:GetItems() or {}} do for _,v in pairs(s) do if v.prefab==[[orangestaff]] then f=v end end end if f then if not b.shown then local r=f.replica.inventoryitem b:SetTextures(r:GetAtlas(),r:GetImage()) b:Show() end elseif b.shown then b:Hide() end end) --M

parts.label: Define the manual-aim teleport action
parts.text: MW_BG=rawget(_G,[[MW_BG]]) or 3 MW_BC=[=[local p=ThePlayer local I=p.components.inventory local s=I:GetEquippedItem(EQUIPSLOTS.HANDS) if not(s and s.prefab==[[orangestaff]]) then s=I:FindItem(function(i) return i.prefab==[[orangestaff]] end) end if s and s.components.blinkstaff then p:PushBufferedAction(BufferedAction(p,nil,ACTIONS.BLINK,s,Vector3(%.2f,0,%.2f))) else p.components.talker:Say([[No staff]],2) end]=] --M

parts.label: Create the targeting reticule
parts.text: local P=ThePlayer local C=P.HUD.controls if C.bm then C.bm:Kill() end if P._br and P._br:IsValid() then P._br:Remove() end local r=SpawnPrefab([[reticule]]) r:Hide() P._br=r local m=C:AddChild(require[[widgets/image]]([[images/global.xml]],[[square.tex]])) C.bm=m m:SetClickable(false) m:ScaleToSize(22,22) m:Hide() local A={} P._bA=A local W,H=TheSim:GetScreenSize() A.f=function(x,y) local g=MW_BG local u=math.max(0,math.min(W,A.px+(x-A.sx)*g)) local v=math.max(0,math.min(H,A.py+(y-A.sy)*g)) local a,_,c=TheSim:ProjectScreenPos(u,v) return a,c,u,v end --M

parts.label: Manage reticule and aim markers
parts.text: local P=ThePlayer local C=P.HUD.controls local A=P._bA local m=C.bm local H=select(2,TheSim:GetScreenSize()) for _,h in ipairs(rawget(_G,[[MW_BH]]) or {}) do h:Remove() end local function N(x,y) local b=C.bl local q=b and b.shown and b:GetWorldPosition() return q and (q.x-x)^2+(q.y-y)^2<(.06*H)^2 end MW_BH={TheInput:AddTouchStartHandler(function(i,x,y) if N(x,y) then A.i=i A.sx,A.sy=x,y local p=P:GetPosition() A.px,A.py=TheSim:GetScreenPos(p.x,0,p.z) end end),TheInput:AddTouchEndHandler(function(i,x,y) if A.i~=i then return end A.i=nil m:Hide() local r=P._br if r and r:IsValid() then r:Hide() end if N(x,y) then return end local a,c=A.f(x,y) if a then TheNet:SendRemoteExecute(string.format(MW_BC,a,c),a,c) end end)} --M

parts.label: Update the aim position and perform the teleport
parts.text: local P=ThePlayer local C=P.HUD.controls local m=C.bm local A=P._bA local wp=C:GetWorldPosition() local sc=C:GetScale().x if P._bat then P._bat:Cancel() end P._bat=P:DoPeriodicTask(.03,function() if not A.i then return end local p=TheInput:GetScreenPosition() local a,c,u,v=A.f(p.x,p.y) if not a then return end local ok=TheWorld.Map:IsPassableAtPoint(a,0,c) local r=P._br if r and r:IsValid() then r.Transform:SetPosition(a,0,c) r.AnimState:SetMultColour(ok and 0 or 1,ok and 1 or 0,.2,1) r:Show() else m:SetPosition((u-wp.x)/sc,(v-wp.y)/sc) m:SetTint(ok and 0 or 1,ok and 1 or 0,.2,.9) m:Show() end end) --M

parts.text: local A=ACTIONS.ATTACK A._mw=A._mw or A.fn A.fn=function(act) local t,d=act.target,act.doer if d and d.prefab==[[wendy]] and t and t.prefab==[[abigail]] then return false end return A._mw(act) end --M:wendy

label: WX TRANSPORT AND SCOUT DRONE CHAT NOTIFICATIONS

parts.label: Create chat notifications and separate scout/delivery counters
parts.text: rawset(_G,[[MW_TDState]],{}) rawset(_G,[[MW_TdArr]],function(kind) local S=MW_TDState local s=S[kind] or {n=0,last=-999,msg=false} S[kind]=s local now=GetTime() local H=ChatHistory local k if s.msg and now-s.last<=60 then for i=1,100 do if H:GetChatMessageAtIndex(i)==s.msg then k=i break end end end s.last=now if k then for i=k,99 do local a=H.history_start-i+1 if a<1 then a=a+100 end local b=a-1 if b<1 then b=b+100 end H.history[a]=H.history[b] end local a=H.history_start-99 if a<1 then a=a+100 end H.history[a]=nil s.n=s.n+1 else s.n=1 end local msg=kind==[[scout]] and [[Scout drone exploration complete (]]..s.n..[[)]] or [[A transport drone has arrived (]]..s.n..[[)]] s.msg=H:AddToHistory(ChatTypes.SystemMessage,nil,nil,nil,msg,{.7,.85,1,1},nil,nil,true) local q=TheFrontEnd:GetActiveScreen() if q and q.networkchatqueue then q.networkchatqueue:RefreshWidgets(true) end end) rawset(_G,[[MW_DS]],{}) rawset(_G,[[MW_DT]],0) rawset(_G,[[MW_TDS]],{}) rawset(_G,[[MW_TDY]],0) --M:wx78

parts.label: Scan scout and delivery drones and announce completion or arrival
parts.text: local P=ThePlayer if P._mwdt then P._mwdt:Cancel() end P._mwdt=P:DoPeriodicTask(.25,function() MW_DT=MW_DT-.25 MW_TDY=MW_TDY-.25 if MW_DT<=0 then MW_DT=2 local N={} for _,v in pairs(Ents) do if v.prefab==[[wx78_drone_scout_globalicon]] then local x,_,z=v.Transform:GetWorldPosition() N[v]=MW_DS[v] or {x=x,z=z,t=0,done=true} end end MW_DS=N end for v,s in pairs(MW_DS) do if v:IsValid() then local x,_,z=v.Transform:GetWorldPosition() if s.x and (x-s.x)^2+(z-s.z)^2>.04 then s.t=0 s.done=false else s.t=s.t+.25 end s.x,s.z=x,z if s.t>=1.5 and not s.done then s.done=true MW_TdArr([[scout]]) end end end if MW_TDY<=0 then MW_TDY=2 for _,v in pairs(Ents) do local p=v.prefab if p and p:find([[^wx78_drone_delivery.*_globalicon$]]) and not MW_TDS[v] then MW_TDS[v]=true end end end for v in pairs(MW_TDS) do if not v:IsValid() then MW_TDS[v]=nil MW_TdArr([[delivery]]) end end end) --M:wx78

label: WURT: MAKE MERM FOLLOWERS STOP TALKING

parts.label: Stop Wurt’s Merm followers talking
parts.text: local P=ThePlayer local function M(v) if v and v:IsValid() and v.prefab and v.prefab:sub(1,4)==[[merm]] and v.components.talker then v.components.talker:IgnoreAll() v.components.talker:ShutUp() return 1 end return 0 end if not P._mwMermHook then P._mwMermOld=P.additional_OnFollowerAdded P.additional_OnFollowerAdded=function(inst,v) if inst._mwMermOld then inst._mwMermOld(inst,v) end M(v) end P._mwMermHook=true end local n=0 for v in pairs(P.components.leader.followers) do n=n+M(v) end c_announce([[Merm silence active: ]]..n..[[ existing followers silenced; new followers automatic]]) --M:wurt

label: WURT TP ALL STRANDED MERMS BACK TO THEIR HOMES

parts.label: Wurt TP all stranded Merms back to their homes
parts.text: local n,k=0,0 for _,v in pairs(Ents) do local s=v.prefab and v.prefab:sub(1,4)==[[merm]] and v.components.homeseeker if s and not v:IsInLimbo() then local h=s.home local f=v.components.follower if f and f:GetLeader() then elseif h and h:IsValid() then if v:GetDistanceSqToInst(h)>225 then local x,_,z=h.Transform:GetWorldPosition() if v.Physics then v.Physics:Teleport(x+2.5,0,z) else v.Transform:SetPosition(x+2.5,0,z) end n=n+1 end else k=k+1 end end end c_announce([[merms moved ]]..n..[[, no home ]]..k)

label: PREVENT OTHER CHARACTERS FROM PICKING UP WINBOT

parts.label: Prevent other characters from picking up Winbot
parts.text: local P=ThePlayer local pc=P.components.playercontroller local lo=P.components.locomotor if pc._po then pc.DoAction=nil pc._po=nil if lo then lo.PushAction=nil end end pc._wb=function(a) if a and a.action==ACTIONS.PICKUP and a.target and a.target.prefab==[[winona_storage_robot]] and P.prefab~=[[winona]] then pcall(function() local t=STRINGS.CHARACTERS local c=t[P.prefab:upper()] or t.GENERIC P.components.talker:Say(c.ACTIONFAIL_GENERIC or t.GENERIC.ACTIONFAIL_GENERIC or [[I can't do that]],2) end) return true end end if not pc._wi then pc._wi=1 if lo then local L=lo.PushAction lo.PushAction=function(s,a,...) if pc._wb(a) then return end return L(s,a,...) end end local D=pc.DoAction pc.DoAction=function(s,a,...) if pc._wb(a) then return end return D(s,a,...) end end --M

parts.text: local P=ThePlayer local H=P.HUD.leafcanopy local C=TheCamera local b=P.HUD.controls.status.heart b._mwloc=b._mwloc or b.OnControl b.OnControl=function(s,c,d) if (c==CONTROL_ACCEPT or c==CONTROL_PRIMARY) and not d then P._mwleafoff=not P._mwleafoff if P._mwleafoff then P._mwsee=PLAYER_CAMERA_SEE_DISTANCE P._mwseeq=PLAYER_CAMERA_SEE_DISTANCE_SQ P._mwcam=C.distancetarget P._mwextra=C.extramaxdist PLAYER_CAMERA_SEE_DISTANCE=C.maxdist PLAYER_CAMERA_SEE_DISTANCE_SQ=C.maxdist*C.maxdist C:SetExtraMaxDistance(math.max(0,130-C.maxdist)) C:ContinuousZoomDelta(130-C.distancetarget) H:Hide() P:DoTaskInTime(.3,function() if P:IsValid() and P._mwleafoff then C:ContinuousZoomDelta(-10) end end) else C:SetExtraMaxDistance(P._mwextra) C:ContinuousZoomDelta((P._mwcam or 41.25)-C.distancetarget) PLAYER_CAMERA_SEE_DISTANCE=P._mwsee PLAYER_CAMERA_SEE_DISTANCE_SQ=P._mwseeq H:Show() end return true end return s._mwloc(s,c,d) end --M
